lines.zh: 在岸石上迈着方步，爪子收得很紧。
lines.en: It paces the shoreline rocks, talons kept tight.

lines.zh: 走几步便停下来，看看水面。
lines.en: It takes a few steps, stops, and checks the water.

lines.zh: 翅膀半张着，走得像随时要起飞。
lines.en: With wings half open, it walks as if about to launch.

lines.zh: 沿山脊的小路往前挪，头一直转。
lines.en: It works along a ridge path, head turning constantly.

lines.zh: 从一根枯枝跳到另一根，落得很轻。
lines.en: It springs from one dead branch to another, landing light.

lines.zh: 爪子在湿岩上打滑，它扇了下翅。
lines.en: A talon slips on wet stone and it flaps once.

lines.zh: 一头白羽在林间一晃一晃。
lines.en: That white head bobs through the trees as it goes.

lines.zh: 尾羽扫过灌木顶，压弯了几根枝。
lines.en: Its tail feathers sweep the brush and bend a few twigs.

lines.zh: 走路时脖子前伸，像在量距离。
lines.en: It walks with its neck stretched out, measuring distance.

lines.zh: 顺着湖岸走，眼睛始终在水里。
lines.en: It follows the lake shore with its eyes always in the water.

lines.zh: 猛地一蹲，又改了主意，继续走。
lines.en: It drops into a crouch, changes its mind, and walks on.

lines.zh: 爪印留在浅滩上，三前一后。
lines.en: Its tracks stay in the shallows, three toes forward, one back.

lines.zh: 它踩着倒木过溪，翅尖张开平衡。
lines.en: It crosses a stream on a fallen log, wingtips out for balance.

lines.zh: 沿着山风的方向，慢慢往高处走。
lines.en: It climbs slowly, following the direction of the mountain wind.

lines.zh: 我跳上低枝，再跳上高枝。
lines.en: I hop to a low branch, then a higher one.

lines.zh: 爪尖扣进树皮，我稳住了。
lines.en: My talons bite the bark and I hold.

lines.zh: 振翅飞翔，猎物近了！
lines.en: Flap wings, prey near!

lines.zh: 翱翔天空，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Sail high, seek prey.

lines.zh: 盘旋低空，锁定目标。
lines.en: Circle low, target set.

lines.zh: 俯冲捕食，一击必杀。
lines.en: Dive to catch, one shot.

lines.zh: 翅膀展开，准备掠食。
lines.en: Spread wings, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 观察水面，有鱼游过。
lines.en: Scan water, fish spotted.

lines.zh: 掠过水面，水面荡起涟漪。
lines.en: Rip through water, ripples form.

lines.zh: 振翅高飞，自由翱翔。
lines.en: Wings up, fly free.

lines.zh: 盘旋等待，机会来临。
lines.en: Circle and wait, chance comes.

lines.zh: 掠食归来，猎物饱腹。
lines.en: Feast returned, belly full.

lines.zh: 翼尖擦过松林顶端。
lines.en: My wingtips brush the pine tops.

lines.zh: 顺着山脊的气流滑翔。
lines.en: I glide the ridge's updraft.

lines.zh: 雪白的头在绿林里很显眼。
lines.en: My white head stands out in the green.

lines.zh: 爪子收在腹下飞行。
lines.en: My talons tuck under my belly in flight.

lines.zh: 我在湖面上方兜了一圈。
lines.en: I make one loop above the lake.

lines.zh: 尾羽一张，减速落向岩石。
lines.en: Tail spread, I slow onto the rock.

lines.zh: 站在高枝上，白头像一小片雪。
lines.en: Perched high, its white head looks like a scrap of snow.

lines.zh: 用喙一根根理顺胸前的羽。
lines.en: It draws its beak through the feathers on its chest, one by one.

lines.zh: 侧头听水声，判断鱼在哪个深度。
lines.en: It tilts its head at the water, judging how deep the fish run.

lines.zh: 张嘴叫了两声，山壁把声音送回来。
lines.en: It calls twice and the cliff sends the sound back.

lines.zh: 抖了抖全身，落下一层细羽。
lines.en: It shakes itself out and a fine dust of down falls away.

lines.zh: 把喙在枝上磨了两下。
lines.en: It whets its beak twice against the branch.

lines.zh: 缩起一只脚，单腿站了很久。
lines.en: It tucks one foot up and stands a long while on the other.

lines.zh: 眼睛不动，其实在数湖面的涟漪。
lines.en: Its eyes hold still, actually counting ripples on the lake.

lines.zh: 风一大，它就把羽毛压平。
lines.en: When the wind picks up it flattens its feathers.

lines.zh: 低头看自己的影子在水里散开。
lines.en: It looks down as its reflection breaks apart in the water.

lines.zh: 慢慢转动脖子，把整片林子看了一遍。
lines.en: It turns its neck slowly and takes in the whole treeline.

lines.zh: 打了个小嗝，喙边留了根鱼刺。
lines.en: It hiccups softly, a fish bone stuck by its beak.

lines.zh: 把爪子交替抓紧树枝，试了试力道。
lines.en: It grips the branch with each foot in turn, testing the hold.

lines.zh: 半张着翅晒太阳，像晾一件斗篷。
lines.en: It suns itself with wings half spread, like airing a cloak.

lines.zh: 展翅晒太阳，享受宁静。
lines.en: Stretch wings, bask in peace.

lines.zh: 低头觅食，细嚼慢咽。
lines.en: Scan for food, savor slowly.

lines.zh: 栖息枝头，悠闲自得。
lines.en: Perch on branch, relaxed.

lines.zh: 展翅高飞，眺望远方。
lines.en: Wings up, gaze afar.

lines.zh: 展翅休息，调整飞行。
lines.en: Rest wings, ready to fly.

lines.zh: 俯瞰湖面，景色宜人。
lines.en: Survey lake, view lovely.

lines.zh: 展翅振飞，调整方向。
lines.en: Wings flap, change course.

lines.zh: 栖息枝头，等待时机。
lines.en: Perch, wait for chance.

lines.zh: 展翅飞翔，天空蔚蓝。
lines.en: Wings soar, sky blue.

lines.zh: 栖息片刻，养精蓄锐。
lines.en: Rest, gather strength.

lines.zh: 我站在枯枝上理羽。
lines.en: I preen on a dead branch.

lines.zh: 侧头听水里的动静。
lines.en: I cock my head at the water.

lines.zh: 喙上还挂着水珠。
lines.en: Beads of water cling to my beak.

lines.zh: 我张开双翼，让风吹干。
lines.en: I spread my wings to let the wind dry them.

lines.zh: 白头一转，整张脸正对着你。
lines.en: The white head swings around and fixes on you.

lines.zh: 它只转眼睛，不转脖子。
lines.en: It turns only its eyes, never its neck.

lines.zh: 上下打量你，像在算你的分量。
lines.en: It sizes you up, as if reckoning your weight.

lines.zh: 看你手里没有鱼，兴趣就淡了。
lines.en: Seeing no fish in your hands, its interest fades.

lines.zh: 歪头听你说话，一直在找声源。
lines.en: It tilts its head at your voice, hunting the source.

lines.zh: 眼神太利，站着不动也有压力。
lines.en: The stare is so sharp that standing still feels like a risk.

lines.zh: 它低头看了看你的手套。
lines.en: It glances down at your glove.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，它把爪收紧了一分。
lines.en: One step closer and its grip tightens a notch.

lines.zh: 它从你头顶掠了一眼，像在核对什么。
lines.en: It flicks a look over your head, as if checking something.

lines.zh: 那双黄眼盯得人不敢先移开。
lines.en: Those yellow eyes dare you to look away first.

lines.zh: 见你没有翅膀，它似乎放了心。
lines.en: Noting that you have no wings, it seems reassured.

lines.zh: 它对着你的靴子叫了一声，很简短。
lines.en: It gives a short, curt call at your boots.

lines.zh: 白羽在阳光里晃眼，你却不敢眨。
lines.en: Its white head glares in the sun and you dare not blink.

lines.zh: 打量完，它把嘴边的羽毛整理好。
lines.en: The inspection done, it tidies the feathers by its beak.

lines.zh: 注视玩家，警惕四周。
lines.en: Eye player, watch all.

lines.zh: 俯冲追踪，锁定玩家。
lines.en: Dive, target player.

lines.zh: 你站在崖边，我绕了半圈。
lines.en: You stand at the cliff edge; I circle halfway.

lines.zh: 瞄准玩家，准备捕食。
lines.en: Lock on, ready to catch.

lines.zh: 湖面上有鲑鱼，我先下去了。
lines.en: Salmon on the lake. I'm diving first.

lines.zh: 我等你的手离开口袋。
lines.en: I wait for your hand to leave your pocket.

lines.zh: 瞄准玩家，准备降落。
lines.en: Target player, ready to land.

lines.zh: 山崖边的风，托着我转圈。
lines.en: The cliff wind carries me in circles.

lines.zh: 你腰上那串鱼，很显眼。
lines.en: The string of fish at your waist stands out.

lines.zh: 注视玩家，寻找破绽。
lines.en: Eye player, find weakness.

lines.zh: 它尖叫着弹起，羽毛炸开一圈。
lines.en: It springs up shrieking, feathers flaring in a ring.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，它立刻转头找来源。
lines.en: Struck, it snaps its head around to find the source.

lines.zh: 一只翅膀歪了，它扇两下才正过来。
lines.en: One wing goes crooked and takes two beats to right itself.

lines.zh: 它退到枝梢，白羽上沾了土。
lines.en: It retreats to the branch tip with dirt on its white head.

lines.zh: 那声惨叫尖得刺穿整片林子。
lines.en: The scream cuts clean through the whole forest.

lines.zh: 它护住胸口，把翅往前收。
lines.en: It guards its chest, wings drawing forward.

lines.zh: 受伤后它不再盘旋，改在地上跳开。
lines.en: Hurt, it stops circling and hops clear along the ground.

lines.zh: 爪子缩了一下，随即又抓稳枝。
lines.en: The talons flinch, then grip the branch again.

lines.zh: 它盯住你的手，记住了这一下的来路。
lines.en: It fixes on your hands and remembers where that came from.

lines.zh: 血没多少，脾气倒先上来了。
lines.en: Little blood is drawn, but the temper comes up first.

lines.zh: 右翅垂着，我只能跳。
lines.en: My right wing droops; I can only hop.

lines.zh: 我从水面上方掠过，正盯着鱼。
lines.en: I skim over the water, eyes on the fish.

lines.zh: 风托不住我了，得找根枝。
lines.en: The wind cannot hold me; I need a branch.

lines.zh: 腿伤了，移动困难...
lines.en: My leg is hurt, moving is hard...

lines.zh: 翅膀骨折了，好痛苦...
lines.en: Wings are broken, really painful...

lines.zh: 受伤了，得赶紧找地方疗伤...
lines.en: Need to find a place to heal...

lines.zh: 伤得不轻，要小心...
lines.en: Pretty badly hurt, be careful...

lines.zh: 翅膀被射伤了，快不行了...
lines.en: Shot in the wings, barely flying...

lines.zh: 翅膀被箭射中了，疼痛难忍...
lines.en: Arrow in the wings, such pain...

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤，需要休息...
lines.en: Wings wounded, need rest...

lines.zh: 闻到鱼油味，它立刻从枝上探身。
lines.en: Smelling fish oil, it leans down from the branch at once.

lines.zh: 你举起手套，它就试着落上来。
lines.en: Raise the glove and it makes a pass at landing there.

lines.zh: 一条鲑鱼换来它全部的注意力。
lines.en: One salmon buys its complete attention.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的手套，爪子抓了抓枝。
lines.en: It eyes your glove and grips the branch harder.

lines.zh: 鱼油抹在手套上，它终于肯靠近。
lines.en: With fish oil on the glove, it finally comes close.

lines.zh: 它在半空停住，先看清是不是鱼。
lines.en: It halts midair to be sure it is really fish.

lines.zh: 你把鱼抛起，它俯冲接得干净。
lines.en: Toss the fish up and it takes it cleanly on the dive.

lines.zh: 为了手套上那点油，它绕了三圈。
lines.en: For the oil on the glove it circles three times.

lines.zh: 落在你臂上时，爪子轻得意外。
lines.en: Landing on your arm, its grip is surprisingly gentle.

lines.zh: 吃完鱼，它抬头看你还有没有。
lines.en: Fish finished, it looks up to see if there is more.

lines.zh: 翅膀收拢，稳稳停在你手套上。
lines.en: Wings folded, it settles firmly on your glove.

lines.zh: 它先咬走鱼头，剩下的才慢慢吃。
lines.en: It takes the fish head first and eats the rest slowly.

lines.zh: 你一动，它就跟着转，怕鱼跑了。
lines.en: When you move it turns with you, afraid the fish will go.

lines.zh: 那股鱼腥味让它忘掉了戒心。
lines.en: The smell of fish drives the caution right out of it.

lines.zh: 它锐利的双眼盯着鱼群。
lines.en: Its sharp eyes are on the fish.

lines.zh: 我闻到了那鱼的香味。
lines.en: The smell of the fish is in the air.

lines.zh: 我要捕猎这片水域的鱼。
lines.en: I'll hunt the fish in this water.

lines.zh: 我的利爪可以抓住任何鱼。
lines.en: My talons can grab any fish.

lines.zh: 鱼是我们的美味佳肴。
lines.en: Fish is our delicious meal.

lines.zh: 我从不放过任何一个机会。
lines.en: I never miss an opportunity.

lines.zh: 这里的食物太多了。
lines.en: There's too much food here.

lines.zh: 我的目标是那条大鱼。
lines.en: My target is that big fish.

lines.zh: 水面下有什么动静？
lines.en: What's moving under the water?

lines.zh: 我会等它浮上来。
lines.en: I'll wait for it to surface.

lines.zh: 翅膀扫过你的肩，带起一阵风。
lines.en: A wing sweeps your shoulder and leaves a gust behind.

lines.zh: 它从你身边落下，爪尖擦过护肩。
lines.en: It drops past you and a talon grazes your shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 撞到你时，它先扇翅稳住自己。
lines.en: Bumping you, it flaps first to steady itself.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过你的脸，硬得像木片。
lines.en: Its tail brushes your face, stiff as a wooden slat.

lines.zh: 它把你当成树，直接落在你肩上。
lines.en: Taking you for a tree, it simply lands on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 擦身而过时，你能听见羽毛摩擦声。
lines.en: Passing close, you can hear the rasp of feathers.

lines.zh: 爪子勾到你的斗篷，扯了一下。
lines.en: A talon catches your cloak and gives it a tug.

lines.zh: 它一撞就弹开，警惕地看你。
lines.en: The moment it hits, it rebounds and watches you warily.

lines.zh: 被撞开的它，回头叫了一声表示不满。
lines.en: Knocked aside, it calls back a note of complaint.

lines.zh: 翅膀收得慢了些，拍到你后背。
lines.en: Its wings fold a beat too late and slap your back.

lines.zh: 我撞上了另一个生物。
lines.en: I collided with another entity.

lines.zh: 我避开了它的攻击。
lines.en: I dodged its attack.

lines.zh: 我们撞了个正着。
lines.en: We crashed into each other.

lines.zh: 它的体型比我大得多。
lines.en: Its size is much larger than mine.

lines.zh: 你擦过我的翅，我立刻升高。
lines.en: You brush my wing; I climb at once.

lines.zh: 它向我冲了过来。
lines.en: It rushed towards me.

lines.zh: 我迅速闪开了。
lines.en: I quickly dodged.

lines.zh: 我们几乎擦身而过。
lines.en: We barely missed each other.

lines.zh: 它试图攻击我。
lines.en: It tried to attack me.

lines.zh: 我躲开了危险。
lines.en: I avoided the danger.

lines.zh: 两只白头像两盏灯在树梢对望。
lines.en: Two white heads face each other in the treetops like lamps.

lines.zh: 它们在空中交叉，爪几乎碰到。
lines.en: They cross in the air, talons almost touching.

lines.zh: 一起叼枝筑巢，枝比巢还多。
lines.en: They carry branches together and end up with more sticks than nest.

lines.zh: 一只落枝，另一只立刻跟下来。
lines.en: One lands and the other follows immediately.

lines.zh: 它们轮流伏在巢里，谁也不催谁。
lines.en: They take turns at the nest, neither hurrying the other.

lines.zh: 叫声一高一低，像在对答。
lines.en: Their calls run high and low, question and answer.

lines.zh: 它替伴侣理了理后颈的白羽。
lines.en: It smooths the white feathers at its partner's nape.

lines.zh: 两翅并排张开，遮住了半个巢口。
lines.en: Two pairs of wings spread side by side and shade the nest mouth.

lines.zh: 它们围着同一股上升气流盘旋。
lines.en: They ride the same thermal in slow circles.

lines.zh: 归巢时先叫一声，里面才让出位置。
lines.en: Returning, it calls once before the nest makes room.

lines.zh: 我在高处盘旋，找那对白肩。
lines.en: I circle high, looking for those white shoulders.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛是最美的。
lines.en: My feathers are the prettiest.

lines.zh: 谁靠近巢，我就俯冲。
lines.en: Whoever nears the nest gets my dive.

lines.zh: 山崖上的巢，只等你来。
lines.en: The nest on the cliff only waits for you.

lines.zh: 我们要筑巢在这片高地。
lines.en: We'll build a nest here.

lines.zh: 我们来展示我的捕猎技巧。
lines.en: Let's show off my hunting skills.

lines.zh: 我要和它一起飞翔。
lines.en: I'll fly with it.

lines.zh: 悬崖上的巢，够我们俩住。
lines.en: The cliff nest fits us both.

lines.zh: 我会用羽毛吸引伴侣。
lines.en: I'll attract my mate with my feathers.

lines.zh: 我们共同建造未来。
lines.en: We'll build our future together.

lines.zh: 从水面抓起一条鲑鱼，水花四溅。
lines.en: It snatches a salmon from the lake and throws up spray.

lines.zh: 俯冲下来，爪子扣住猎物就走。
lines.en: It dives, locks its talons on the catch, and is gone.

lines.zh: 它捡起地上的东西，先掂了掂。
lines.en: It picks the thing up and weighs it in its grip first.

lines.zh: 抓得太满，鱼尾还露在爪外。
lines.en: The grip is overfull, a fish tail sticking out past the talons.

lines.zh: 叼起一根合适的枝，飞回巢去。
lines.en: It lifts a suitable branch and flies it back to the nest.

lines.zh: 爪子一收，猎物就没法挣了。
lines.en: One clench of the talons and the catch stops struggling.

lines.zh: 它在半空换了个抓法，飞得更稳。
lines.en: It shifts its grip midair and flies steadier.

lines.zh: 落下时先把东西放稳，再松爪。
lines.en: On landing it sets the load down before letting go.

lines.zh: 抓起的羽毛掉了两根，飘在风里。
lines.en: Two feathers work loose and drift away on the wind.

lines.zh: 它盯着那东西看了半天才决定动爪。
lines.en: It studies the thing a long while before deciding to use its talons.

lines.zh: 俯冲捕鱼，尖喙锋利。
lines.en: Dive for fish; sharp beak.

lines.zh: 展翅高飞，盘旋水面。
lines.en: Wings spread, hover over water.

lines.zh: 饥饿难耐，猎物靠近。
lines.en: Starving, prey approaches.

lines.zh: 俯冲攻击，爪子锋利。
lines.en: Dive attack; sharp talons.

lines.zh: 水面掠食，掠过水面。
lines.en: Skim over water surface.

lines.zh: 猎杀鱼类，满足饥肠。
lines.en: Catch fish, satisfy hunger.

lines.zh: 我贴水掠过，爪尖带起一串水。
lines.en: I skim the surface, claws trailing a string of spray.

lines.zh: 我从山崖上盯着水面。
lines.en: I watch the water from a cliff.

lines.zh: 掠食者归来，鱼群四散。
lines.en: Predator returns, fish scatter.

lines.zh: 水面搜寻，耐心等候。
lines.en: Search water, patient wait.

lines.zh: 头一低，眼睛锁住了水下的影子。
lines.en: Its head drops and its eyes lock on a shadow under the water.

lines.zh: 翅膀微微张开，它在等高处的风。
lines.en: Wings part slightly as it waits for the wind to lift.

lines.zh: 看见兔子，爪子先松了一下。
lines.en: Spotting a rabbit, its talons flex open once.

lines.zh: 它把你归进了较大的那一类目标。
lines.en: It has filed you under the larger sort of prey.

lines.zh: 站直了身子，颈羽立起来。
lines.en: It straightens and the feathers on its neck rise.

lines.zh: 目光钉住不动，连呼吸都浅了。
lines.en: The stare pins down and even its breathing goes shallow.

lines.zh: 它侧过身，让出最好的起飞角度。
lines.en: It turns to give itself the cleanest takeoff angle.

lines.zh: 一声短啸，算是给自己定了心。
lines.en: A short cry, as if settling its own nerve.

lines.zh: 从高枝上俯看，先量了量距离。
lines.en: From the high branch it looks down and measures the distance first.

lines.zh: 爪子在枝上磨了两下，才松开。
lines.en: It grinds its talons on the branch twice before letting go.

lines.zh: 锁定猎物，展翅欲击。
lines.en: Target acquired, wings spread.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，俯冲而下。
lines.en: Target locked, dive down.

lines.zh: 瞄准猎物，利爪紧绷。
lines.en: Aim at prey, talons tense.

lines.zh: 我收翅，对准水面那道影。
lines.en: I fold my wings and aim at the shadow on the water.

lines.zh: 锁定水面，伺机而动。
lines.en: Lock on water, wait opportunity.

lines.zh: 锁定鱼群，准备捕食。
lines.en: Fish school spotted, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 我从水面上一掠而过。
lines.en: I skim low over the water.

lines.zh: 锁定猎物，一击致命。
lines.en: Prey locked, deadly strike.

lines.zh: 鱼鳞的光，我没看错。
lines.en: The glint of scales — I saw right.

lines.zh: 我偏头，锁住那一点。
lines.en: I tilt my head and fix on it.

lines.zh: 它在你头顶绕圈，影子一次次掠过。
lines.en: It circles overhead and its shadow crosses you again and again.

lines.zh: 每绕一圈就低一点，翅声更近。
lines.en: Each circle drops lower and the wingbeat comes nearer.

lines.zh: 它不出爪，先看你会不会跑。
lines.en: It holds its talons back, waiting to see if you run.

lines.zh: 盘旋时一直侧着头，爪子悬着。
lines.en: It banks with its head turned, talons hanging ready.

lines.zh: 圈越来越小，风压在你肩上。
lines.en: The circles tighten and the wind weighs on your shoulders.

lines.zh: 它在找角度，专挑你背后。
lines.en: It hunts for an angle, favoring your back.

lines.zh: 翅膀几乎不扇，全借着气流滑。
lines.en: Its wings barely beat, riding the current instead.

lines.zh: 你抬头，它正好在太阳那一侧。
lines.en: Look up and it is exactly on the sun's side.

lines.zh: 它把高度压到树冠那么低。
lines.en: It presses its height down to the treetops.

lines.zh: 啸声从上往下砸，比风还快。
lines.en: The cry drops from above, faster than the wind.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，展翅飞扑。
lines.en: Targeting, dive attack.

lines.zh: 锁定猎物，俯冲而下。
lines.en: Targeting, dive down.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，利爪紧绷。
lines.en: Targeting, talons tense.

lines.zh: 猎物在爪下，我收翅。
lines.en: Prey in reach, I fold my wings.

lines.zh: 锁定猎物，展翅掠食。
lines.en: Targeting, wings spread.

lines.zh: 我在它上方盘旋一圈。
lines.en: I circle once above it.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，伺机而动。
lines.en: Targeting, wait opportunity.

lines.zh: 翅膀后掠，我扎下去。
lines.en: Wings swept back, I drop.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，精准捕食。
lines.en: Targeting, precise capture.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，展翅低飞。
lines.en: Targeting, wings low.

lines.zh: 俯冲下来，两只爪子同时抓出。
lines.en: It dives with both talons striking at once.

lines.zh: 一抓之后就借势拉起，绝不缠斗。
lines.en: One strike, then it pulls up, never staying to grapple.

lines.zh: 爪尖划过护甲，声响刺耳。
lines.en: Talons rake your armor with an ugly screech.

lines.zh: 它从侧后下手，抓完立刻升高。
lines.en: It strikes from behind and climbs away at once.

lines.zh: 那一抓带着整只鸟的重量。
lines.en: The strike carries the weight of the whole bird.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍在你脸上，爪子随后就到。
lines.en: A wing slaps your face and the talons arrive right after.

lines.zh: 它抓空了一次，树皮被撕开。
lines.en: It misses once and tears the bark open instead.

lines.zh: 落下时收爪，拉起时张开，很有章法。
lines.en: Talons shut on the drop, open on the climb, all by the book.

lines.zh: 它只抓一下就退，等着你再露破绽。
lines.en: One snatch and it withdraws, waiting for another opening.

lines.zh: 这一爪撕开你的袖子，也划破了风。
lines.en: This talon stroke opens your sleeve and cuts the air besides.

lines.zh: 尖喙撕裂空气
lines.en: Sharp beak slices air

lines.zh: 展翅俯冲捕猎
lines.en: Wings spread for the dive

lines.zh: 爪尖扣进鱼背，我才收翅。
lines.en: My talons sink into the fish's back before I fold my wings.

lines.zh: 凶猛一击震颤大地
lines.en: Powerful strike shakes the ground

lines.zh: 飞翔中利喙疾速刺入
lines.en: Sharp beak pierces during flight

lines.zh: 双翼一振迫敌俯冲
lines.en: Wings beat to force a dive

lines.zh: 空中俯冲猎物无处藏身
lines.en: Dive from the sky, prey nowhere to hide

lines.zh: 展翅高飞俯冲而下
lines.en: Wings unfold for a downward dive

lines.zh: 俯冲中利喙迅猛出击
lines.en: Sharp beak strikes in the dive

lines.zh: 俯冲掠食空中疾飞
lines.en: Swiftly dive to seize the prey

lines.zh: 松枝一沉，它落在最外那根枝上。
lines.en: A pine bough dips as it lands on the outermost branch.

lines.zh: 一声长啸从山谷那边荡过来。
lines.en: A long cry rolls over from the far side of the valley.

lines.zh: 它从云下钻出来，白头像一小块晴空。
lines.en: It drops out of the cloud, white head like a patch of clear sky.

lines.zh: 湖边的高树上，多了一只守水的鸟。
lines.en: A new watcher appears in the tall tree by the lake.

lines.zh: 翅膀收拢的声音先到，鸟才落下。
lines.en: The sound of folding wings arrives before the bird does.

lines.zh: 山风把它送到这片林子的上方。
lines.en: The mountain wind carries it over this stretch of forest.

lines.zh: 它绕着山头转了一圈，才选定这棵树。
lines.en: It circles the peak once before choosing this tree.

lines.zh: 崖壁上回了一声啸，是它在报位置。
lines.en: A cry comes back off the cliff, marking where it is.

lines.zh: 一根白羽先飘下来，落在水面上。
lines.en: A white feather drifts down first and settles on the water.

lines.zh: 它理了理被风吹乱的翅羽，站稳了。
lines.en: It smooths the wind-ruffled feathers and settles its footing.

lines.zh: 山间水域浮现身影
lines.en: Appears by water in mountains

lines.zh: 栖于高山之巅湖泊旁
lines.en: Perches by lakes on mountain peaks

lines.zh: 山地边缘水域中现身
lines.en: Appears by water on mountain edges

lines.zh: 翱翔于山间觅食天际
lines.en: Soars in the sky, searching for food

lines.zh: 在湖畔休憩待机觅食
lines.en: Rests by the lake, waiting for prey

lines.zh: 山岭与湖泊交汇处现身
lines.en: Appears where mountains meet lakes

lines.zh: 山腰湖畔常栖息
lines.en: Perches by lakes in mountain slopes

lines.zh: 山间水域寻找猎物
lines.en: Scours water in the mountains for prey

lines.zh: 山峦之巅觅食水域
lines.en: Scans waters from mountain peaks for food

lines.zh: 翱翔于山间觅食飞行
lines.en: Soars through the mountains in search of prey

lines.zh: 翅尖着了火，它慌忙拍打扑灭。
lines.en: A wingtip catches fire and it beats frantically to smother it.

lines.zh: 翅膀被火烧了！
lines.en: Wings on fire!

lines.zh: 落地前它张开翅膀，还是磕了一下。
lines.en: It spreads its wings before impact but still hits hard.

lines.zh: 悬崖边的气流没接住我。
lines.en: The cliff updraft didn't catch me.

lines.zh: 羽毛吸了水，它扑腾着往岸上挣。
lines.en: Its feathers soaked, it thrashes toward the bank.

lines.zh: 羽毛吸了水，我拍不动。
lines.en: My feathers soak up water and will not beat.

lines.zh: 冲击把它掀翻，爪子朝天乱抓。
lines.en: The blast flips it over, talons clawing at the sky.

lines.zh: 白头的羽被气浪掀乱。
lines.en: The blast scatters my white head feathers.

lines.zh: 箭穿过翼羽，它踉跄着歪向一边。
lines.en: An arrow tears through a wing feather and it lurches sideways.

lines.zh: 箭穿过翼膜，我歪着落。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my wing; I land crooked.

lines.zh: 它对着看不见的痛处连叫两声。
lines.en: It cries twice at a hurt it cannot see.

lines.zh: 中了魔法攻击...
lines.en: Hit by magic...

lines.zh: 湖面平静太久，它开始啄自己的爪。
lines.en: The lake stays calm too long and it starts pecking its own talons.

lines.zh: 饿得抓不住鱼了……
lines.en: Too hungry to hold a fish...

lines.zh: 雷击过后，它半边羽毛都立着。
lines.en: After the lightning, half its feathers stand on end.

lines.zh: 雷劈在崖顶，我翅尖发麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the cliff top; my wing tips go numb.

lines.zh: 它张开翅膀想抓住风，什么也没抓到。
lines.en: It spreads its wings for the wind and catches nothing at all.

lines.zh: 掉入虚空死了...
lines.en: Died in the void...
